subtitles.en: Denives of York for lives writing we expect robust results from Nvidia which will be key to the tech trade going higher into year rent. Dan joins us now for more. Dan Goodmorning.
subtitles.zh: 丹·艾夫斯预计英伟达业绩强劲，这将推动科技股在年底前走高。丹现在加入我们，早上好。

subtitles.en: Great to be here. What's getting more expensive? With memory. I mean, the reality is that we're seeing a memory super cycle take place and
subtitles.zh: 很高兴来到这里。什么变得更贵了？内存。实际上，我们看到内存超级周期正在发生。

subtitles.en: I think that's the word all around Korea and that's why Nvidia they're going to need to pass on those their customers. But that's not that's not slowing down because the reality today
subtitles.zh: 我认为这是韩国那边的普遍说法，这就是为什么英伟达需要将成本转嫁给客户。但这并没有减缓需求，因为现实是

subtitles.en: demand the supply for chips is upwards of 15 to one. And I think that's that's what not just Nvidia but ultimately they're end users. Who needs to eat the higher costs right now?
subtitles.zh: 芯片的供需比高达15比1。我认为这不仅对英伟达，最终对其终端用户也是如此。现在谁需要承担更高的成本？

subtitles.en: Who's eating it? Now through the supply chain you'll see some of that eating but then ultimately it's the end user it's the customers it's enterprises it's tokenization as that all plays out then
subtitles.zh: 谁在承担？现在通过供应链，你会看到一些承担，但最终是终端用户、客户、企业，以及代币化，随着这一切的发展，

subtitles.en: the question will be okay when you hit some sort of equilibrium. I mean we don't think you hit core equilibrium probably till middle to late 2028. And I think that right now is a quagmire
subtitles.zh: 问题将是，当你达到某种平衡时。我们认为要到2028年中后期才能达到核心平衡。我认为现在是一个泥潭。

subtitles.en: whether it's Nvidia whether it's the memory player is micron everyone else because the hyperscalers you know just like as Lisa talked like as they'll continue to raise capital and catbacks will
subtitles.zh: 无论是英伟达还是内存厂商美光等，都陷入困境，因为超大规模企业，就像丽莎说的，他们会继续筹集资金，回购也会继续增加。

subtitles.en: continue to increase the AI revolution still in the third inning and I think you'll hear that more for Nvidia where this week then it comes down to like memory and Apple and obviously seeing that
subtitles.zh: AI革命仍在第三局，我认为你会从英伟达那里听到更多，本周然后归结为内存和苹果，显然看到

subtitles.en: front center those costs going to continue go up. They're going to look for other costs to go down though and I was looking for example at the story over the weekend of Nvidia potentially telling some
subtitles.zh: 这些成本将继续上升。他们会寻找其他成本降低，比如我周末看到的故事，英伟达可能告诉一些

subtitles.en: of its customers like Microsoft and Alphabet and Oracle that their costs are going to go about 15%
subtitles.zh: 客户如微软、Alphabet和甲骨文，他们的成本将上涨约15%。

大机构/名人 + 被逼/陷阱/真相/转向 等张力词，例如 野村辜朝明：日本央行被逼到墙角
具体数据 + 政策动作疑问，例如 6月PMI释放积极信号，政府会加码吗
